 LYON and Saint want to keep the international success streak going. Following a strong finish at MSI, the NA #2 seed is back at Worlds with high expectations.
 During the Worlds 2026 Asset Day, LYON Saint shared with us what happened in a scrim against HLE and his goals for his Worlds debut.
 Image Credit: Riot Games/Hotspawn 
 How are you doing?
 Saint : I’m fine.
 Davide : How have scrims been going?
 Saint : Pretty good.
 Davide : Are you willing to share any details? Has a team stood out or made a good impression?
 Saint : We scrimmed against HLE, and Dhokla went 15/0/2 while Zeus went 0/10/2.
 Davide: That gives you some confidence, then. This is your first Worlds. What’s one thing you’re looking forward to?
 Saint : Improving and beating LCK mid laners.
 Davide : Any name in particular?
 Saint : ShowMaker.
 Davide : Do you have any thoughts on North America’s chances this year? C9 struggled a little in play-ins .
 Do you think that hurts the region’s chances, or do you think LYON can still do well?
 Saint : From what I saw in play-ins, C9 seemed to have control of their series, but somehow they still lost. I thought their opponent was a pretty good team, although the mental side may have been an issue. I don’t think the LEC is better than the LCS, too.
 Davide : We’re EU media, so that hurts a little, but we’ll take it.
 Saint : We’re going to prove ourselves on stage.

 Davide: Is “GODS” your favorite because of the artist or the song itself?
 Saint : Both.
